# coreapp-v1_sim_link (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) SimLinkSpec defines the desired state of SimLink (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String) name of the SimLink
- `namespace` (String) the namespace scope in which to operate
- `status` (Attributes) SimLinkStatus defines the observed state of SimLink (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `links` (Attributes List) To create a point to point link with a single interface on both sides use a single link object.
To create a point to point link with a LAG configured on both side, use two links with matching nodes.
A multihommed lag is created by using two or more links where the remoteNode and/or localNode can be different.
Creating a link with only localNode specified will create an edge interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--links))

Optional:

- `bond_name` (String) When creating a SimLink with more than one member, the bondName is used to create a bond on the SimNode side.
This field must not be used when creating a single member SimLink.
